english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone cannot resist doing V or reacting in a certain way.
Use this for an action caused by an irresistible urge, especially laughing, crying, or speaking.

examples.english: Seeing his funny face, I irresistibly burst out laughing.
examples.traditional: 睇到佢個樣咁搞笑，我忍唔住笑咗出聲。
